verdict.rationale: PostHog documents native HogQL (SQL-equivalent) querying with SELECT/JOIN/WHERE/GROUP BY directly on events, persons, sessions and warehouse-synced data, both in the UI (SQL insights) and via a programmatic /query API endpoint with HogQLQuery kind. This is well-documented first-party across multiple docs pages and the query-endpoint reference. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically validating SQL insight query performance/UX (community evidence is mostly about unrelated topics like LLM cohort bugs or old Postgres scaling concerns).
